title: Mad Science
description: This card's type and effects are dynamically determined by TinkerTime mechanics. Its base effect depends on which type it becomes: [Attack] Deal 12 damage, [Skill] Gain 8 [gold]Block[/gold], or [Power] Apply a class-specific effect. Additionally, it may have a rider effect that applies one of these additional mechanics: [Sapping] Apply 2 [gold]Weak[/gold] and 2 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], [Choking] Whenever you play a card this turn, the enemy loses 6 HP, [Energized] Gain 2 [gold]Energy[/gold], [Wisdom] Draw 3 cards, [Chaos] Add a random card into your [gold]Hand[/gold] (free to play this turn), [Expertise] Gain 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 2 [gold]Dexterity[/gold], [Curious] Powers cost 1 [gold]Energy[/gold] less, or [Improvement] At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card. If the Attack type has the Violence rider, it deals 12 damage 3 times.

notes: Special event card with TinkerTime mechanics. The card dynamically transforms between Attack, Skill, and Power types at runtime via the TinkerTimeType property. Target also varies based on type: Single (Attack) or Self (Skill/Power). The TinkerTimeRider property determines which, if any, of 8 possible rider effects are applied. Not shown in the card library (shouldShowInCardLibrary: false). When upgraded, adds Innate keyword allowing the card to be drawn at the start of combat.
